summary: Tested new Newsletter, Pages CMS overrides, and dynamic donation packages. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests passed (newsletter subscribe + dedupe, auth-gated list/broadcast, broadcast sends via Resend, /api/pages GET+PUT auth, dynamic donation_packages reflected in /api/donations/packages and enforced server-side at checkout). Frontend: /resurse/newsletter shows both publications (pub-lumina, pub-renasterea) and form (newsletter-form, newsletter-email, newsletter-submit) with success toast on submit. Newsletter link appears in Resurse desktop nav and in ResourcesHub grid. Admin panel exposes all 8 tabs including tab-pages and tab-newsletter; PagesManager edits persist and reflect on home after reload (verified TEST_HERO marker); NewsletterManager has broadcast-subject/body/send + subscriber list with delete; SettingsManager has add-package, package-amount-0, package-del-0, settings-save.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py newsletter_subscribe correctly dedupes on lowercased email and returns already:true without resending welcome — good.
server.py /api/pages GET is public (list all overrides) which is expected since SiteContentContext loads it on app mount without auth; PUT correctly requires admin auth.
donation checkout resolves amount from settings.donation_packages via get_donation_packages(), verified with runtime override test (seed set to 77 RON => 7700 minor units in Stripe session).
newsletter_delete uses ObjectId(sub_id) — will raise if a non-ObjectId string is passed; consider wrapping with try/except to return 400 instead of 500. Not encountered in normal flow.
server.py exceeds 700 lines (744) — recommend splitting newsletter, pages, donations into separate routers for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Temporary newsletter subscribers created and cleaned up per test. Home page override was set to TEST_HERO_xxx and reset to empty after verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run tests with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported (pytest does not auto-source frontend/.env). Existing tests: backend_test.py (base), test_donations.py (Stripe), test_new_features.py (newsletter/pages/dynamic-donations). Do NOT complete real Stripe payments. When testing page overrides, remember SiteContentContext caches /api/pages at app mount — always do full navigation/reload after PUT /api/pages/*.
